name: Evnia Control

brightness.keys: native sun keys and bare F1/F2
event_tap_preference: HID for existing volume and F1/F2
session for native brightness only; full session fallback if HID unavailable
brightness.native_key_reception: keyDown/keyUp via primary HID and brightness-only session tap

keyboard_controls: always enabled; media keys require Accessibility access
appearance: Liquid Glass window, solid white opaque slider thumbs in light and dark modes, primary-color percentage labels
cleanup: retired source files and build caches during installation
validation: Static checks on Linux. Swift/AppKit build and hardware behavior must be verified on target Apple Silicon macOS 27+ Mac.

menu_bar.second_left_click: close main panel, keep app running

distribution: separate EN source edition with localized install script; compiled macOS app not included
